description: Semi-automated FE Renovate upgrades: mark npm dependencies for auto merge by default and keep a human in the loop only for the 'Common across DC' cases from https://hello.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DCCore/pages/7424609152/Human+review+required+-+Enable+semi-automated+FE+Renovate+upgrades. The merge is done by renovate-automerger, which merges on the [renovate:auto-merge] commit marker alone; Renovate's own automerge is not used. So commitBody is the only switch: the default rule sets the marker, every opt-out rule resets it with commitBody: [renovate:manual-merge].

packageRules.description: Mark FE dependencies for auto merge by default. Everything that must keep a human in the loop is opted back out below by resetting commitBody. The bar for opting out is that a human would intervene even on a green build.
Public API and platform versioned. These follow SemVer well, so minor and patch upgrades auto merge, but major upgrades require coordination across DC.
Public API and platform versioned, and not reliably SemVer (almond is still 0.x), so minor upgrades can contain breaking changes as well.
Any dependency still at 0.x: per SemVer minor upgrades can contain breaking changes.
Atlassian owned, without security problems or transitive dependencies, so there is no reason to upgrade. Renovate does not even raise PRs.
